name: Проклятие! Потеря двух карт
alt: Две карты превратились в бумажных птиц и улетают в разные стороны.
prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Asset type: one square original illustration for a humorous fantasy card game, readable at 384 by 384 pixels. Funny expressive caricature, bold clean ink outlines, loose watercolor and gouache on warm parchment, colorful accents. One obvious visual joke, simple chunky shapes, minimal background, centered large subject with comfortable margins. Modest detail, no intricate scenery. No text, letters, digits, logos, watermark, border or card frame. Clear anatomy, no extra limbs. Subject: An adult fantasy adventurer looks aghast as two blank-backed playing cards turn into little paper birds and fly away in opposite directions. His two hands reach after them, exactly two cards and two arms, no writing or visible card faces.
